categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes src/wallet/test/fuzz/spend.cpp to fuzz wallet transaction creation, coin control, and funding APIs.
categories.rationale: Adds stateful fuzzing coverage for wallet transaction creation, FundTransaction, ListCoins, and manual coin selection. The expanded test coverage helps uncover potential wallet spend edge cases, though it does not address an active bug or fund-safety regression.
